_doc: Part C panel sets (CMAZE-T, words-plus-observation (BOTH) TEST, persisted w19 objects). One entry in panel_sets = one figure; one entry in arms = one column. A second pass (improved CLU config) adds its arm column(s) here and its per-item re-read beside cmazet_items.json; no code change. The 10x-read-floats diagnostic is not a matched rival (never a bar) and is not drawn.

arms.key: arm: BLIND-COLOUR (learned: colour identity removed from the request)
arms.name: blind colour

arms.key: arm: BLIND-SEQUENTIAL (learned: main effects only, no interaction terms)
arms.name: blind sequential

panel_sets.notes: One held-out TEST n-way transition per rule family: the first in the scorer's capped order at seed 0, else at the first seed that has one. Columns: s_t with the action, the engine's s_{t+1}, then each arm's generated s_{t+1} (apply_outcome of its own emission) with the exact judge's mark.
Door-then-tint (interaction family): the first seed-0 TEST n-way row per move direction present. Same columns as fig_cmazet_families.

For every arm, one seed-0 TEST n-way transition on which it is right and one on which it is wrong, each a uniform draw (numpy default_rng(21), arms in manifest order) among the qualifying rows; an arm with no qualifying row gets no row (recorded in selection).

Value deletion of colour 1 (the deleted colour recorded in the artefact), seed 0: on surviving-colour TEST n-way rows (the rows the deletion rows score), the first per rule family. Columns: the CLU before deletion, after the downdate, and fitted without the rows (the deletion pair; equal emissions on every surviving row, recorded), and the matched MLP as trained and retrained without.

panel_sets.awaiting: the w21_clu module (see w22 NEEDS-ARTEFACTS.json): the REL pickles cannot be loaded without it, so gate 2 (local re-read == scored run JSON) cannot run and nothing is drawn. When it lands: a REL reader in cmazet_extract.py writes data/cmazet_items_rel.json; flip status to landed.
panel_sets.notes: Same selection rule as fig_cmazet_per_arm, for the CLU-REL-A10 objects, with the six +rel diagnostic arms as extra columns.
